method: Codex Chromium at 390x844. Release 5 uses a deterministic localhost Fast-4G proxy with gzip text responses, 150 ms latency and 1.6 Mbps transfer; five navigations per state read the privacy-safe feed-performance.v1 record after first-card hydration.

baseline.description: Release 2 boundary before the Release 3 static-first loading changes

release2FreshOrigin.note: The first sample includes the initial service-worker and cold-origin cost.

release3FreshOrigin.note: Fresh default preferences render fewer cards than Release 2, so this is a first-card latency measure rather than a full-list throughput comparison.

release3Configured.note: Configured state exercises the long feed and remains below the separate configured-feed target.

release4MissionCritical.note: Every run requested page-001 only before interaction and no canonical season or extra fixture bundle. The 70ms median is 78.4% below the recorded 324ms Release 2 baseline.

release5Fast4G.note: Anonymous cold clears the origin cache. Warm runs use the installed v131 stale-while-revalidate shell. Signed cold uses that installed shell with a unique user/feed-contract cache key on each run, so the personalised page always comes from the one network request; signed warm measures IndexedDB first-page readiness while the same single request reconciles in parallel.
